claims: Porto is a UNESCO World Heritage city in Portugal.
Porto has port wine cellars in Vila Nova de Gaia.
Port wine was first developed in Vila Nova de Gaia in the 17th century.
Ribeira District is a riverside neighborhood.
Livraria Lello and Majestic Cafe are often linked to J.K. Rowling's inspiration.
Dom Luís I Bridge is a metal bridge.
Porto Cathedral (Sé) is one of the city's oldest sites.
Porto has a population of around 250,000 residents.
The Douro River is the source of the port wine vineyards.
Guimarães is known as the birthplace of Portugal.
